messages:
Nate R: Solaris (HW partner) wants a tight perf/W + kernel flags sweep for marketplace copy. Scope: power caps 60/80/100W, batches 1/2/4, quant q8,q4_0, and reproducible kernel cmdlines. They want a 1-line headline (delta_Throughput@80W) but full curves too.

Ken H: I'll run the harness and standardize telemetry. CSV fields: run_id,node,batch,seq,quant,power_cap,avg_watt,throughput,p50,p95,kv_hit,kernel_flags. 250ms sample interval.

Priya V: I'll draft the one-pager but will only publish claim after stats (p<0.05). Also need reproducibility appendix: BIOS, microcode, kernel cmdline md5.

Marta V: ops note: we'll pin BIOS v2026-04-01 and microcode v2026-03-10. Two control nodes on vendor kernel, four test nodes. Capture inlet temp.

Ken H: draft command:
```bash
./bench --model sol-13b --seq 768 --batches 1,2,4 --quant q8,q4_0 \
  --power-cap 60,80,100 --kernel-sets stock,latency_tuned \
  --telemetry nvml,rapl,pmu --telemetry-interval 250 \
  --out s3://redwood-partner-bench/solaris/<run>/ --trace ndjson
```

Nate R: schedule: Wed 08:00 UTC, 6 nodes, ~90m per config. bench-bot will post live logs.

bench-bot: scheduled solaris-20260708-01, starts 2026-07-08T08:00:00Z. live logs: https://bench.redwood.internal/solaris-20260708-01

bench-bot: job solaris-20260708-01/2 finished: batch=2 quant=q4_0 power_cap=80 avg_watt=79.1 throughput=13.8 p50=20.4 p95=46.2 kv_hit=0.90. artifacts -> s3://redwood-partner-bench/solaris/solaris-20260708-01/results/part-0002.jsonl

Ken H: initial glance: latency_tuned kernel improved p95 ~9% and gave +4.5% throughput at 80W vs stock. I'll run bootstrap CI and upload aggregates.

Priya V: thanks. Action items: Ken (final stats + CSV schema), Marta (node temp validation), Nate (partner sync + one-pager draft after stats). Meeting to review Fri 16:00 UTC.
